trip_paths.name: Relaxed Wine Weekend
trip_paths.vibe_summary: A slower-paced, food-forward trip with plenty of downtime and flexibility.
trip_paths.who_it_fits: Best for those who want to unwind, enjoy meals together, and avoid a packed schedule.
tradeoffs: Fewer scheduled activities may feel under-planned to some.
watchouts: Advance reservations needed for popular wineries.
Consider separate activities for those who want more structure.

trip_paths.name: Curated Highlights Getaway
trip_paths.vibe_summary: A balanced itinerary with one anchor experience per day, leaving room for spontaneity.
trip_paths.who_it_fits: Works well for groups who want clarity and highlights without feeling over-scheduled.
tradeoffs: Less spontaneous flexibility than Path A.
Some higher-cost experiences (fancy dinner, curated tours).
Hotel lodging is more expensive than rental.
watchouts: Daily pacing needs to be realistic to avoid fatigue.
Build in buffer time between activities.

notes_for_ui: Only 2 of 6 participants have responded; consider prompting remaining participants before finalizing.
Show this summary to the organizer first; allow sharing after a path is selected.
The wide budget gap suggests discussing cost expectations before booking.
